rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now that the squares have names, so do the moves. That way a game can be written down.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: A move is written with the piece's letter and the square it goes to. R is the rook.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Rd7 means: the rook goes to the d7 square.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Rd7: the rook on d7.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes up the d-file to d7. That is Rd7.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: The rook stopped on another square. Let's go back: the number gives the rank, 7.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: You do not write where the rook came from, only where it arrived.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: the piece's letter and the destination square, like Rd7.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: When the piece captures, an x goes between the letter and the square.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Rxe5 means: the rook captures the piece on e5.
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! Rxe5: the rook captured the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes up to e5 and captures the pawn. That is Rxe5.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not capture on e5. Let's go back: the x asks for a capture.
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The x tells the reader that there was a capture. The square is that of the captured piece.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now I will show the letters of all the pieces and the signs for check and mate.
rot.demos.letras.e1: Each piece has its letter: K is the king and Q is the queen.
rot.demos.letras.l1: R is the rook, B is the bishop and N is the knight.
rot.demos.letras.l2: For example, the knight goes to c3: Nc3. The bishop goes to c4: Bc4.
rot.demos.peao.e1: The pawn has no letter: its move is just the square.
rot.demos.peao.l1: The pawn goes to e4, and the move is written e4.
rot.demos.peao.l2: When capturing diagonally, the pawn takes the letter of the file it left: exd5.
rot.demos.sinais.e1: A check gets a + at the end of the move. Checkmate gets a #.
rot.demos.sinais.l1: The rook goes to a8, and it is checkmate: the move is written Ra8#.
rot.demos.sinais.l2: If it were only check, without mate, it would be Ra8+.
rot.demos.sinais.l3: Now it's your turn: I write the move, and you play it.
rot.pratica.xeque.enunciado: Play Qh5+. You do not play the +: it only says it is check.
rot.pratica.xeque.fim: Perfect. Qh5+: the queen on h5, giving check.
rot.pratica.xeque.err.d1d5: That square is d5. The move asks for h5: the letter h, the last file. Try again.
rot.pratica.mate.fim: Well done. Rd8#: the rook on d8, and it is checkmate. You can write moves now.
